batch_policy: original groups of four sorted baseline meanings within each direction for IT2/NLLB; E3 single-row batches for MADLAD
decoder_cache: original model default for IT2/NLLB; disabled for MADLAD
baseline_policy: fresh same-forward raw/mask measurements; old baseline retained as a comparison
target_support: exact original reference lexical-label rows, model-specific unknown handling retained

mask_protocol.blank: strip SentencePiece/byte-BPE boundary markers and whitespace; empty remainder
mask_protocol.separator_localization: also save prefix blank mass before the first language-control position versus remaining body blanks; diagnostic subsets, not extra closure components
mask_protocol.punctuation_P: nonempty remainder consists entirely of Unicode category P characters
mask_protocol.symbol_control: remaining positions classified punctuation under original all-P/S/Z/C rule
mask_protocol.raw_P_only: original lexical mass + symbol/control mass; symbols treated as lexical under this alternative operational rule; blank remains nonlexical
mask_protocol.conditional_original: original lexical / (original lexical + original broad punctuation), excludes original controls
mask_protocol.conditional_no_separator: original lexical / (original lexical + pure punctuation + symbol/control), excludes blank separately
mask_protocol.harmonized_unknown: remove source unknown from numerator/denominator for all systems; original target support remains unchanged
